name: labs/amsikking__asi_ms_2000_500_cp
title: ASI MS-2000-500-CP stage controller (asi_MS_2000_500_CP.Controller)
intro: ASI MS-2000-500-CP stage controller (asi_MS_2000_500_CP.Controller), adapted from amsikking/asi_ms_2000_500_cp. It reads `position_x`, `position_y`, `position_z` and `motor_moving`; sets `pwm_intensity` and `pwm_state`; runs `move_stage`. `move_stage`: move the X, Y and Z stage axes to absolute positions in micrometres and wait for the controller to verify the target. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
